name: Sagrada

setup.text: Put the Round Track near the middle.
Shuffle the Tool cards and put 3 face up in the middle.
Shuffle the Public Objective cards (blue die on back) and put 3 face up.
Put all 90 dice in the bag.
Take 1 Private Objective card (grey die on back) face down. You may look at it in secret.
Take 2 Window Pattern cards and a Window Frame board. Pick one pattern, either side, and slide it into the bottom of the board.
Take Favor tokens equal to the difficulty number on your chosen window.
Take the score marker matching your board colour and put it beside the Round Track.
Choose a random start player and give them the dice bag.

turn.summary: Each round the start player draws dice and rolls them into a pool. Everyone then takes two turns, in a snake order.
steps: The start player pulls the right number of dice from the bag at random and rolls them to form the Draft Pool.
On your turn you may draft 1 die and place it on your window, and/or use 1 Tool card. Both are optional, in either order, and you may pass.
Place dice by the rules: your first die goes on an edge or corner space; every later die must touch a placed die, including diagonally.
A die must match the colour or value of its space. White spaces accept anything.
A die may never sit next to a die of the same colour or value, side by side.
To use a Tool card, put 1 Favor token on it if it has none, otherwise 2, then use its ability.
Turns go clockwise. After the last player's first turn, play runs back in reverse order for second turns.

round_end: Put leftover dice from the pool on the Round Track, covering that round's number.
Pass the bag clockwise. That player is the next start player.
end: The game ends after round 10. Flip the Round Track to its score side and score.

scoring.text: Score each Public Objective card. You can score from the same card more than once.
Row and column objectives only score for complete rows or columns with no open spaces.
Add your Private Objective: the sum of the values of your dice in the colour it names.
Add 1 point per unspent Favor token.
Lose 1 point for each open space on your window.

tiebreak: Most Private Objective points, then most Favor tokens left, then reverse player order in the final round.

missed.text: Dice count as the same if they share a value, not just a colour, so two 3s of different colours still cannot be orthogonally adjacent.
Diagonal contact is enough for a die to touch a previous one, but the no-matching rule applies only to side-by-side dice.
The first Tool card use costs 1 Favor token. Once a token is on it, using it costs 2.
You may choose not to draft a die on a turn.
Setup is the same for 2, 3 and 4 players. Only the number of dice drawn changes.
If someone finds an illegal die in a window, they remove dice of their choice until it is legal. Those dice leave play and the open spaces cost points.

not_covered: Solo play (1 player), which uses a Target Score and different tool rules.
Individual Tool card abilities, public and private objective card details, which are printed on the cards.
